high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "bloomberggreen," which is located in Denmark. The post features an illustration depicting a climate plan to store captured CO2 in North Sea oil reservoirs. The illustration shows a factory emitting CO2 into the atmosphere, which is then captured and transported via a pipeline to be stored underground in an oil reservoir. The text on the post reads: "A Danish climate plan to store captured CO2 in North Sea oil reservoirs moves a step closer." This indicates that the project is advancing towards implementation or approval.
